title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
description: Add a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstarts for the docs site and redwood-examples. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to bootstrap retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use cases with agents that perform tool-calling (search, DB lookup, and external API calls) and to provide curated templates for common workflows (customer support summarization, knowledge base Q&A, and semantic search pipelines). This PR includes: - RAG agent templates (templates/agents/rag-*.yaml) with configurable retriever and tool bindings - Three tool-calling example agents implemented in redwood-examples (python and typescript): customer-support-agent, kb-answering-agent, and analytics-query-agent - Quickstart guides in redwood-docs/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstarts.md and small snippets included in the docs site config for sidebar integration - Small changes to redwood-examples to add sample data and a test harness for the examples - Docs site build and CI adjustments to include the new quickstarts Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and examples - [x] Add quickstart docs and sidebar entry - [x] Update examples README and sample data - [x] Run unit + integration tests for examples - [x] CI config updates to build docs Notes: kept code changes minimal and examples intentionally small to avoid large diffs in the monorepo. Also added guidance on when to prefer the templates vs. building a custom agent. See linked Linear issues for acceptance criteria.
